source.citation: Alvord, John W. A Report to the Street Paving Committee of the Commercial Club on the Street Paving Problem of Chicago. Chicago: R. R. Donnelley & Sons, 1904.
what_it_does_not_supply: the surface of any street, alley, curb or walk in the 1904 grid
what_it_supplies: the pavements available to a Chicago street in 1904 (sheet asphalt, granite and stone block, brick, round cedar block, macadam, creosoted block in trial) and their mileage at 1 January 1904
period guidance on which pavement suited residence streets, busy streets and alleys
